note: Marlboro County SC: the county's GIS is a Think GIS/wthgis web viewer (marlborosc.wthgis.com) with no discoverable ArcGIS REST endpoint; ArcGIS searches for Marlboro zoning found no FeatureServer/MapServer of zoning districts. The county's parcel service on SCDOT (smpesri.scdot.org SC_Parcels/MapServer/33) requires a token. Bennettsville publishes its zoning only as PDF maps (2019 and 2022); no McColl/Clio/Blenheim zoning service was found. Only commercial sources (Regrid, Dynamo) carry zoning attributes.
